facts.statement: The genus Rukwatitan was described by Gorscak et al. in 2014.
Rukwatitan is classified within the unranked family Titanosauria.
The time range for Rukwatitan spans from the Cenomanian to the Campanian, between 100.5 and 72.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Cenomanian to Campanian (100.5 to 72.2 million years ago)

facts.statement: Rukwatitan measured approximately 9.1 meters from head to tail and had forelimbs estimated at around 2 meters long.
facts.quote: medía 9,1 metros desde la cabeza hasta la punta de la cola, y tenía extremidades anteriores que se estimaban en alrededor de 2 metros.

facts.statement: Rukwatitan lived in the middle of the Cretaceous period, approximately 100 million years ago during the Albian stage, in what is now Africa.
facts.quote: vivió a mediados del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente 100 millones de años, en el Albiense, en lo que hoy es África.
